findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_synthesizer.py:61 validates policy booleans and summary counts only against one another, not against evaluate_blocking(), source dispositions, adjudication, or reviewer success aliases. A schema-valid critical unreviewed fix can have every policy flag and blocker count changed to false/zero, and a successful reviewer can be changed to success=false while remaining in eligible_vendors; validate_consensus_payload() accepts both false-zero and false-quorum reports.
findings.resolution: Recompute every finding's policy from canonical source dispositions and validated adjudication, derive summary counts from those recomputed decisions, and require reviewer success vendors to equal the canonical eligible-vendor set. Validate all remaining compatibility aliases, including recommended disposition and source membership, before accepting or persisting a report.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_synthesizer.py:432 still derives successful reviewers, quorum_received, and synthesis inputs from VendorResult.success. VendorResult carries no validated attempt chain and the module does not import the shared quorum predicate, so direct and CLI callers can promote legacy success records without attributable terminal model/vendor evidence.
findings.resolution: Extend the synthesizer input boundary with validated logical-attempt provenance, apply is_quorum_eligible() to a distinct-vendor set, and reject or audit-only every success-only input. Make the CLI consume the round manifest/attempt chains rather than inferring eligibility from findings-file presence.

findings.description: Critical: skills/merge-pull-requests/scripts/vendor_review.py:321 is the task-2.6 compatibility caller but still reports and synthesizes any r.success result with findings, including legacy ReviewResult objects with no terminal attempt chain. This bypasses the shared predicate and can create PR-review consensus from ineligible evidence.
findings.resolution: Import and apply the shared eligibility predicate, deduplicate terminal vendors, retain failed chains for audit, and synthesize only validated eligible logical results. Add regressions using a success-only legacy result with non-empty findings.

findings.description: Critical: skills/merge-pull-requests/scripts/vendor_review.py:347 serializes review_type="pr", but all production, frozen, and installed consensus schemas allow only plan or implementation. The compatibility caller therefore returns a consensus object that the newly mandatory shared validator rejects.
findings.resolution: Use a supported canonical review type or add and install an explicitly versioned PR review type across the review-findings and consensus contracts, then call validate_consensus_payload() before returning the compatibility result.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_synthesizer.py:493 still builds clique groups through a first-fit pass ordered by vendor and local finding id. In a weak A-B/B-C bridge, assigning the same concerns to different vendor names changes whether A-B or B-C is grouped, which changes group identifiers and can change blocker counts; the required stable-fingerprint order and vendor-independent grouping are not implemented.
findings.resolution: Generate and score all bounded candidate edges, sort concerns and edges by vendor-independent normalized concern fingerprints, and build deterministic complete-link groups without a first-seen vendor anchor. Add a regression that permutes vendor identities across the same A/B/C concerns and dispositions.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_synthesizer.py:657 accepts duplicate adjudication-ledger entries for one group_id and applies them sequentially. The same exact-fingerprint ledger produced blocking_count=0 for [deferred,fixed] and blocking_count=1 for [fixed,deferred], so file order can grant or revoke a waiver instead of duplicate keys failing closed.
findings.resolution: Validate the ledger as a unique map keyed by group_id plus exact fingerprints before applying any entry, reject duplicate or conflicting keys atomically, and require applied_adjudications to have the same uniqueness invariant in the shared consensus validator.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_attempts.py:244 enforces the advertised outer logical deadline only when called on the main thread. In a worker thread a 50ms logical timeout waited for a blocking 250ms adapter call to return before recording timeout, so the public bound is not an interrupting boundary for server/threaded callers and a hung adapter can still hold the review indefinitely.
findings.resolution: Use a cancellable execution primitive that works outside the process main thread and terminates or cooperatively cancels owned subprocess/SDK work at the remaining deadline. Add a worker-thread regression asserting wall time remains bounded and no owned task survives.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_routing.py:78 accepts an HTTP resolver response without a tier and review_dispatcher.py persists only archetype/tier/phase, dropping routing source and resolution fallback reason. The live round-4 manifest resolved every premium reviewer model but recorded tier=null for all five slots, so the prior routing-provenance blocker remains reproducible.
findings.resolution: Make the public resolver return or locally derive the canonical archetype tier, extend requested-routing provenance with resolution source and fallback reason, preserve those fields through the attempt schema/manifest, and add a live-shaped HTTP response fixture that omits tier.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_dispatcher.py:461 claims copied-skill support but searches only openspec/schemas/review-findings.schema.json. A copied parallel-infrastructure skill ships the schema under install_assets/openspec/schemas, so outside a repository with a top-level schema every otherwise valid vendor response is classified invalid_output.
findings.resolution: Resolve the colocated install_assets schema before repository development paths, matching the portable consensus and review-attempt lookup order, and replace the current cwd-only test with a subprocess copied-install execution that validates a real findings payload.
